title: FIND ... NO-ERROR without an AVAILABLE check swallows the failure and dereferences an unavailable buffer, yielding the Unknown value
sourceContent:
/* lookup-price.p - look up a unit price (unsafely) */
DEFINE INPUT  PARAMETER pcItem  AS CHARACTER NO-UNDO.
DEFINE OUTPUT PARAMETER pdPrice AS DECIMAL   NO-UNDO.

FIND FIRST PriceList WHERE PriceList.ItemNum = pcItem NO-LOCK NO-ERROR.
/* No IF AVAILABLE check! If the item has no price row, the buffer is
   NOT AVAILABLE and PriceList.Price returns the Unknown value (?). */
pdPrice = PriceList.Price.
notes: NO-ERROR suppresses the runtime error from a failed FIND; without a following IF AVAILABLE guard, the failure is swallowed and the subsequent PriceList.Price dereferences an unavailable buffer, returning the Unknown value (?) rather than a real price. The Java target must guard the lookup (Optional / null check) and decide how to represent 'no price' — this is a latent bug the SME must confirm.
